newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Three issues to debut on Slovenia's OTC market.
newsitem.headline: Three issues to debut on Slovenia's OTC market.

text.p: Slovenian paint maker Helios, marina operator Marina Portoroz and publisher Gorenjski Tisk will list their shares on Ljubljana's over-the-counter (OTC) market on September 19, the bourse said on Friday.
Helios will list 149,505 shares with a nominal value of 10,000 tolars ($74) per share, representing 68 percent of the company's equity capital.
Marina Portoroz will list 125,572 shares each with a nominal value of 2,000 tolars, accounting for 40 percent of the firms equity capital.
Gorenjski Tisk will list 602,440 shares with a nominal value 1,000 tolars per share representing 56.3 percent of the company's equity capital.
The bourse said it expected to list the shares of another 13 newly-privatised firms by the end of the year.
Currently, there are 24 shares traded on the primary market and 20 on the OTC segment of the Ljubljana bourse. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
